title: helm(private): stabilize values schema + initHooks for PSP/nodeSelector compatibility and upgrade/rollback
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: private deployments (VPC/on-prem) frequently hit upgrade failures when clusters enforce PodSecurityPolicy/PSP or stricter pod-level constraints (nodeSelectors, required tolerations). This causes initJobs used by the helm chart (init-hooks) to fail during upgrades/rollbacks which leads to broken rollback paths and customer downtime. This PR introduces a stabilized values schema with clear compatibility knobs for PSP/PodSecurity/admission-webhook clusters, improves templating for init hooks so they are restartable and idempotent, and adds an explicit rollback path for migrations and initJobs. Changes are backward-compatible by default but include an opt-in "compat" block when clusters require legacy PSP-like behavior.

Summary of changes: 1) values.schema.json updated to v3 with new top-level fields: compat.psp.enabled (bool), compat.psp.policy (string), compat.nodeSelector/affinity/tolerations under install.agent for tighter node placement control, and initHooks.restartPolicy and initHooks.backoffLimit settings. 2) Chart templates: init-job templates refactored to use a shared helper that adds tolerations/nodeSelector/affinity from values and respects compat.psp flags by switching to a compatible securityContext when enabled. 3) Added pre-upgrade and post-rollback hooks that annotate successful init completion so the helm upgrade/rollback controller can skip re-running long-running migrations on transient failures. 4) Added tests: unit helm template test cases, and a small integration harness (k3s) used in CI to validate upgrade/rollback of the private release with and without PSP compatibility. 5) Docs: values.md and upgrade-notes.md describing knobs and recommended practices for on-prem clusters. 6) Minor RBAC and serviceaccount scoping updates to minimize privileges for initJobs when compat.psp.enabled = false.

Checklist: - [x] values schema bump and validation tests - [x] preserve backwards compatibility (default behaviors unchanged) - [x] add migration/rollback annotations - [x] integration smoke tests - [x] docs updated

Commits summary: - feat(values): bump values.schema.json to v3 and add compat.* fields - refactor(init): extract init-hook helper template and add restart/backoff controls - fix(rollback): add post-rollback hook to clean partial migrations and annotate status - test(ci): add k3s-based upgrade/rollback e2e matrix - docs: document new values and upgrade guidance

Changed files (high level): - charts/redwood-private/values.schema.json (new v3 schema) - charts/redwood-private/values.yaml (example adjustments) - charts/redwood-private/templates/init-job.yaml (refactor + compat logic) - charts/redwood-private/templates/_helpers.tpl (new shared helpers) - charts/redwood-private/templates/hooks/pre-upgrade-job.yaml - charts/redwood-private/templates/hooks/post-rollback-job.yaml - charts/redwood-private/templates/serviceaccount.yaml (scoped SA for initJobs) - tests/helm/k3s/upgrade_rollback_matrix.yml - docs/values.md and docs/upgrade-notes.md

Notes on backwards compatibility: defaults are set to preserve current chart behavior. The new compat.* block is disabled by default. Enabling compat.psp will revert to a restricted securityContext shape that matches clusters running legacy PSP or a strict PodSecurity admission policy. Customers upgrading from older charts should run the included k3s smoke test (CI harness) in a staging cluster prior to production upgrade if their cluster enforces pod security policies.
